headline: Mamata Machinery's RecTech receives APR Design recognition in the US
hook: US validation for recycled packaging technology
summary: Mamata Machinery announced that its RecTech product has received APR Design recognition for recyclability in the United States. This certification validates the environmental compliance of the company's technology in a key international market. Such green recognitions can strengthen the company's export profile in North America. For retail investors, this operational milestone highlights the firm's global product standards without an immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Export prospects strengthen via US environmental validation.

headline: Mamata Machinery files SEBI Regulation 74(5) compliance certificate for Q2 FY27
summary: Mamata Machinery has submitted its SEBI Regulation 74(5) compliance certificate for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. This routine regulatory filing confirms the proper dematerialisation and rematerialisation of share certificates during the quarter. The document is submitted to stock exchanges as part of standard corporate governance requirements. Retail investors do not experience any direct financial impact from this administrative filing.
why_it_matters: Routine paperwork with no impact on your portfolio value.
